text: Here's the twist. That paper from day one. Not paying a loan is not a crime. The Supreme Court said it in twenty nineteen: being unable to repay is not cheating. {dramatic} But on day one, you signed an auto-debit mandate. And when that bounces... the law treats it like a bounced cheque. It can mean up to two years in jail. Rare. But real. {deadpan} The loan can't put you in jail. Your signature can.
